## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Note any migration, client update or deployment requirement.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run check:architecture`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration:local`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration:persistence`
- [ ] `npm audit`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`
- [ ] Affected browser or shared-workspace checks run, or verification limits stated
- [ ] Workspace isolation, version guards, idempotency, untrusted-data handling, request limits and Workers compatibility preserved
- [ ] Only synthetic data included; no Site URLs, credentials, deployment identity or private handoffs

List checks not run and explain why.
